high_level_description: This image is a sponsored advertisement from the Instagram account "mokobara." The ad features a person walking on a cobblestone street, holding a large, stylish duffel bag. The individual is dressed in dark clothing, including a black jacket and black pants, which contrasts with the vibrant colors of the bag. The duffel bag is predominantly blue with green accents, including the handles and some decorative stitching. It has a structured design with a flap that appears to be made of leather or a similar material, adding a touch of sophistication.
